Calories in Empanada gallega (Galician pie)

A serving of Galician pie (150 g) has 400 kcal, 267 kcal per 100 g: 12 g protein, 42 g carbs and 20 g fat. Below: what a real serving weighs, where the calories come from and how it compares with similar dishes.

Average values. Your own plate can be above or below: the recipe, the oil and the size of the serving move the number more than any table. Sources are at the end of the page.

How big is a real serving?

Fotocal counts Galician pie as 1 portion, 150 g, the way it is usually served in Spain: 400 kcal. Half of that is about 200 kcal; a serving and a half, about 600.

Where the calories come from

Of every 100 kcal in Galician pie, about 45 come from fat, 42 come from carbs, 12 come from protein.

Frequently asked questions

How many calories are in Galician pie?

A serving of Galician pie (1 portion, 150 g) has 400 kcal: 12 g protein, 42 g carbs and 20 g fat. Per 100 g it is 267 kcal.

Where do the calories in Galician pie come from?

Mostly from fat: about 45 of every 100 kcal. The rest is protein 12%, carbs 42%.

How many calories are in half a serving or a bigger one?

Half a serving (75 g) is about 200 kcal; a serving and a half (225 g), about 600 kcal. For any other amount, weigh it and multiply the grams by 267, then divide by 100.
